description: TypeScript type definitions and function signatures for creating memoized selectors, including createSelector with multiple overloads for different numbers of input selectors, supporting homogeneous, heterogeneous, array-based, and variadic selectors, as well as utility functions for creating structured selectors and custom selector creators.

methods.name: createSelector
methods.description: Overloaded functions for creating memoized selectors with varying numbers of input selectors, supporting homogeneous, heterogeneous, array-based, and variadic inputs, returning either OutputSelector or OutputParametricSelector.

methods.name: createSelectorCreator
methods.description: Function to create custom selector functions with specified memoization strategies.

methods.name: createStructuredSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector that returns an object with the same keys as the input selectors, which are combined into a single structured output.

methods.name: defaultMemoize
methods.description: Utility function for memoizing functions with custom measure and equality check.
